name: California Data Broker Registry
sectors: Commercial personal-data brokerage, including sensitive-data categories
what_it_covers: The California Privacy Protection Agency says this registry includes businesses that operated as data brokers in 2025 and submitted annual registration information.
limitations: California reporting is not a worldwide or universal census. Registration is not agency endorsement, and absence from a registry does not establish nonexistence, compliance, or misconduct.
app_handling: After explicit approval, the app can download this CSV and retain only broker names, DBAs, and the registrants' public website fields. It does not retain contact details or sensitive-practice disclosures, and does not independently verify entries.

name: California Delete Request and Opt-out Platform (DROP)
sectors: Active data brokers participating in California DROP
what_it_covers: California's official information says eligible residents can submit a deletion request covering active data brokers in DROP; the state describes broker response statuses and processing timelines.
limitations: This is a California resident portal, not an all-jurisdiction broker directory. Exempt and publicly available information may remain, and the portal may report pending, opted-out, exempted, deleted, or record-not-found outcomes.
app_handling: Users access and operate DROP directly. The app does not collect DROP identity details, submit requests, or independently verify portal outcomes.

name: Oregon Data Broker Registry information
sectors: Commercial sales or licensing of covered brokered personal data
what_it_covers: Oregon's Division of Financial Regulation explains the state registration requirement and the covered categories of brokered personal data.
limitations: The reviewed page is registration guidance, not an imported or complete roster of businesses. Oregon's statutory scope does not define all data brokers worldwide.
app_handling: The app links to the official guidance only; it does not crawl filings or infer a company's registration or legal compliance.

name: Texas Secretary of State Data Broker Registry guidance
sectors: Businesses within the Texas statutory data-broker definition
what_it_covers: The Texas Secretary of State FAQ describes the registration requirement, links to its registry search, and explains information available for registered brokers.
limitations: The registry applies to Texas law and its statutory definition. The Secretary of State says registration is not agency approval or endorsement; an unregistered search result alone does not prove a violation.
app_handling: The app links to official guidance; users must review the registry themselves. The app does not query the search portal or make legal-compliance findings.
